annotations.title: 7-day city weather forecast (wind, rain probability, WMO code)

description: [Kyreos, 0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Any city name, geocoded. Returns 7 days of daily high/low temperature, precipitation sum, max precipitation probability, max wind speed, dominant wind direction, WMO weather code, and units, plus lat/lon and timezone. Open-Meteo data. Input: {"city":"Lagos"}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/weather-city-7day?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.002 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.002 USDC on Base)
